description: The Robotics jar opener easily opens even the toughest jar lids! It's as easy as setting It down on the lid, pressing the button and watching it work! The Robot-strong vice of the robot twist locks on tight to the lid of any jar and unscrews it effortlessly. The next time you've got a tough jar to handle, count on robot twist to give you the muscle you need!  .
